This Service Agreement sets out the terms under which the Firm provides bookkeeping services to the Client. The Client entered into this Agreement for the provision of ongoing bookkeeping support. Please read this document carefully and retain a copy for your records.

1. SERVICES

The Firm shall provide the following services to the Client:

1.1 Monthly bookkeeping, including the recording of income and expenditure, bank reconciliations, and the preparation of monthly management accounts.

1.2 Processing of supplier invoices and customer receipts, including the raising of sales invoices where requested by the Client.

1.3 VAT return preparation and submission to HMRC, including the reconciliation of the VAT control account.

1.4 Payroll services for up to four (4) employees, including the calculation of PAYE and National Insurance, and the submission of RTI returns.

1.5 Preparation of year-end accounting records and provision of a file to the Client's external accountant for the preparation of statutory accounts and corporation tax returns.

1.6 Ad hoc bookkeeping support by telephone and email, and the provision of up to two (2) hours of additional remote support per month to resolve queries raised by the Client.

2. FEES

2.1 The Client agrees to pay the Firm a monthly fee for the services set out in Clause 1. The fee is payable monthly in advance by direct debit, on or before the first working day of each calendar month.

2.4 The Firm may revise the fee by giving the Client not less than thirty (30) days' written notice. Any revised fee shall take effect from the start of the next calendar month following the expiry of the notice period.

2.5 Where the Client requests services outside the scope of Clause 1, the Firm shall provide a separate quotation. No additional fees shall be charged without the Client's prior written agreement.

2.6 All fees are exclusive of VAT, which shall be added at the applicable rate.

3. TERM AND TERMINATION

3.1 This Agreement shall commence on 1 April 2019 and shall continue until terminated by either party in accordance with this Clause 3.

3.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving the other party not less than ninety (90) days' written notice.

3.3 The Firm may terminate this Agreement immediately by written notice if the Client fails to pay any sum due under this Agreement within thirty (30) days of the due date.

3.4 Upon termination, the Client shall pay all fees due up to the date of termination. The Firm shall provide the Client with all books, records, and data belonging to the Client within fourteen (14) days of termination and following receipt of all outstanding fees.

3.5 Clauses relating to confidentiality, limitation of liability, and data protection shall survive termination of this Agreement.

4. CLIENT RESPONSIBILITIES

4.1 The Client shall provide the Firm with accurate and timely information required for the provision of the services, including bank statements, receipts, invoices, and payroll data.

4.2 The Client shall retain original documents and records as required by law and shall make them available to the Firm on request.
